name: Staggered Particles Effect
description: Full-area background of a glowing grid of particles that trails the pointer with a staggered delay, pulses outward from the center, and drifts on its own when idle.
contents: Square grid of glowing rounded particles on a solid background
behavior: Particles follow the mouse or touch with a delay that grows from the center outward
Periodic pulse wave scales particles up from the center
After 1.5 seconds without input the grid moves on its own along a looping path
Particles blend additively for a glow
editableByProps: Grid size, particle size, spacing and roundness
Particle hue and saturation, background color
Follow delay, update frame rate and pulse interval

needsCodeEdit.change: Start the grid from a corner instead of the center

fixed: Root is absolutely positioned and fills the nearest positioned ancestor
Listens to document mousemove and touchmove, removed on unmount
Viewport size for the idle path is measured once on mount
